articles.title: Race against time: India’s demographic dividend has a window of just 15 years or so before ageing sets in
articles.summary: India faces significant economic challenges, with no international agency projecting growth above 6.7% from 2020-2030. A major concern is job creation, as the nation requires 12 million new non-farm jobs annually but currently generates only half that amount. This highlights a critical need for policies to accelerate growth and employment opportunities for India's large youth population.
